chief_complaint: smooth round wrist lump that transilluminates
hpi_details: 26-year-old female presents with a painless, smooth, round lump on the back (dorsum) of her left wrist that she noticed a month ago. It fluctuates slightly in size with activity but never hurts.
ideas: She thinks it might be a small pocket of joint fluid that formed from repetitive typing at her office job.
concerns: She is worried that the lump could secretly be a malignant growth or bone tumor under her skin.
expectations: She hopes the doctor can drain the fluid with a needle today so her wrist goes back to normal.

reference_soap.subjective:
Chief Complaint: smooth round wrist lump that transilluminates

26-year-old female presents with a painless, smooth, round lump on the back (dorsum) of her left wrist that she noticed a month ago. It fluctuates slightly in size with activity but never hurts.
reference_soap.objective: Exam reveals a 1.5 cm smooth, firm, well-circumscribed, non-tender nodule over the dorsal scapholunate joint. Transillumination test is positive (the mass lights up uniformly when a penlight is placed against it).
reference_soap.plan: Reassurance. Explain that it is a benign fluid-filled cyst originating from the joint capsule. Watchful waiting is recommended as >50% resolve spontaneously. Can offer aspiration or surgical excision if it becomes painful or cosmetically bothersome.

history.answer: I noticed a smooth, round bump on the back of my left wrist about a month ago.

It is about the size of a small grape, maybe one and a half centimeters, and there are no other lumps.
It feels smooth and pretty firm, but it moves slightly under my skin instead of being stuck to the bone.
No, it does not hurt at all, even when I press directly on it.
Yes, when I type for hours or do heavy lifting, it swells up slightly, but resting makes it shrink back down.
I can move my wrist normally in all directions, though it feels slightly tight when I bend my wrist all the way back.
No, I do not have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in my hand or fingers.

No, it has never bled, formed scabs, or broken open.
No, there is no redness, warmth, swelling around it, or pus.
No, there is no little black dot in the center and nothing cheesy comes out.
No, I have never sprained, broken, or injured this wrist, and I have never had surgery on it.
No, I have never had a lump like this before, and I have not tried popping or squeezing it.
No, I have not had any fever, chills, or unexplained weight loss.
